title: Lanterns to the Neon Pyramid
description: A lone figure in a teal hooded cloak stands at the base of a massive, multi-tiered futuristic pyramid, holding a glowing lantern. Strings of warm lanterns hang along the pyramid's ascending pathways, which are embedded with glowing rectangular windows against a swirling purple nebula background, all framed within a complex metallic mechanical border.
prompt: A solitary figure in a flowing teal hooded cloak stands in the lower right, holding a glowing lantern while looking up at a towering, geometric multi-layered pyramid that dominates the scene. Strings of warm paper lanterns hang across the pyramid's ascending steps, which feature glowing rectangular windows. The pyramid rises through swirling purple and violet nebulae with sparkling particles. The entire scene is viewed through a complex industrial metallic frame with pipes, wires, and rivets, in a detailed digital painting style.
